title: Tommaso Mastino.
html_source: “Thomas the Mastiff,” or rather Saint Thomas Aquinas, on whose philosophy and theology Dante based his Divine Comedy. Joyce creates another isosceles triangle among the three great Italians, to whose “impetuosity” Joyce points here. If “isosceles”, who among the three in this triangle would he suggest is the hypotenuse as a representation of singular greatness? Perhaps Dante, despite his reliance on Aquinas.
